Как завести свои колонки и метки на доск: How do I set up my own columns and labels on the board?
Click **Set up the board** above the board. Every board has it, the board of all projects too.
На вкладке «Колонки» выберите проект: ко: On the Columns tab choose the project: each project has its own columns.
Колонки перетаскивают за значок слева, н: Drag columns by the handle on the left, edit a name right in its row, the trash deletes a column. "+ Add column" adds a new one, for example "Waiting for the client" or "In review". Everything is saved at once.
Вид колонки задает, что считается сделан: The column category sets what counts as done: "To do", "In progress" or "Done". Open tasks, the meeting agenda and the answers to the AI assistant go by the category.
При удалении колонки ее карточки перенос: When a column is deleted, its cards move to the column you choose, by default the first one of the same category.
На вкладке «Метки» название правят прямо: On the Labels tab edit a name right in its row, click the circle to change the color, the trash takes the label off every card. Labels are shared by all projects.
Название колонки можно поправить и на до: You can also fix a column name on a project board by double-clicking it. The board of all projects has the three base columns, and a card from a project column shows its name. The last column of a category can't be deleted.
